definitions.CA_mCov: For each eligible GT instance j, max_i IoU(P_i,G_j), then mean across all GT including missed instances as zero. All classes collapsed.
definitions.CA_mWCov: Same best-GT IoU, weighted by GT reference vertex count. Vertex weighted, not physical triangle-area weighted.
definitions.CA_mAR_all: Mean of TP_t / total_GT for IoU thresholds 0.50:0.05:0.95, strict > and V3 one-to-one matching, all predictions, no maxDet cap. Not COCO AR@100.
definitions.R25_R50_R75: TP/(TP+FN) at strict IoU>0.25/0.50/0.75 under the same V3 one-to-one matcher.
definitions.P25_P50_P75: TP/(TP+FP), excluding V3 void-majority unmatched predictions at each corresponding threshold.
definitions.SQ50: Mean IoU of correctly matched pairs at IoU>0.50; conditioned on true positives.
definitions.GT_surface_coverage: Assigned eligible GT vertices / all eligible GT vertices, regardless of instance identity.
definitions.Completeness: Per GT maximum intersection / GT size over any predicted instance; average across all GT including misses as zero.
definitions.Purity: Per eligible nonempty prediction maximum intersection / prediction size; mean across predictions, exclude void-majority predictions as in existing V3 diagnostics.
definitions.merge_split_duplicate: Existing V3 pairwise 2cm support diagnostics, with >=10 vertices and >=5% of GT; unchanged.
